caption: The drawing depicts a single pink slip-on shoe viewed from the side, occupying the lower central area of the paper. The shoe has a slightly pointed toe, a curved upper edge with a scalloped design near the instep, and no visible heel. The inside lining of the shoe is lightly shaded with a beige color, while the exterior is predominantly pink with some shading to suggest contours and depth. Above and to the left of the shoe, there are two simple outline sketches of the shoe's sole, viewed from above, left uncolored and rendered in thin pencil lines. The background is a plain, lighly textured beige, giving the entire drawing a neutral appearance. In the bottom left corner, there is a small inscription with the artist's name and a reference number.
title: Woman's Slipper
